Subject: Preflight: Guest onboarding + room-tagging instructions for Redwood Exec Workshop

Hi Luis / Hilton events team,

Thanks for confirming the block for our executive workshop (Oct 19-21). I attached a concise preflight checklist to make checkin smooth. A few items we need from the hotel operations team before final arrival: 

- Apply a temporary door hanger tag for any rooms flagged as "quiet-preference" (see column G on the manifest). Label: SILENT-HANGER.
- Group keycards by arrival cohort (3 groups: Early 7-9am, Mid 11am-2pm, Late 5-8pm). Please place cohort tabs on the keycard envelope.
- Make sure ADA and crib requests are pre-staged on floors 2 and 3 per the manifest.
- Hold 5 rooms for late-arrival executives with late check-out the following day (we'll confirm names by Oct 12).

Attached: preflight_onboarding_checklist.pdf (short checklist) and a draft mapping of room tags in the sheet we discussed. Claire (Acme) will share VIP dietary flags separately.

Can you confirm by EOD Monday that ops can accommodate the three cohort keycard groups and the SILENT-HANGER tags? Also share the point contact on duty for the event (name & cell).

Thanks — I’ll be onsite the morning of Oct 19 to do a quick walkthrough.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Program Manager, Events 
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: preflight_onboarding_checklist.pdf

Subject: Re: Preflight: Guest onboarding + room-tagging instructions for Redwood Exec Workshop

Hi Jasmine — thanks for the clear checklist. We can support the SILENT-HANGER door tags and the three arrival cohorts. A few clarifying questions before we lock the staging plan: 

1) For the keycard grouping, do you want cohorts separated by building entrance or by floor cluster? We recommend floor cluster to reduce lobby congestion.
2) Do you have a finalized VIP list for dietary flags and allergy notes? We can coordinate with our culinary team if we get the CSV by Oct 12.
3) Which 5 rooms should be held for late-checkout? We can provisionally reserve the west-wing suites; confirm by Oct 12 as well.

I attached our assignments_sheet.xlsx with an example of how we propose to tag envelopes and log them at bell. Please review and tell me what column headings you'd like changed.

Point contact for the weekend: Mark Reynolds, Events Manager — +1 (619) 555-0247 (will be onsite 10/18-10/21).

Luis Morales

Luis — this looks great. A couple quick clarifications from my side (so ops has everything):

- VIP dietary flags: Claire Turner (Acme) will send vip_flags.csv by EOD Oct 6. For your team: column will be Name | Room | Allergy | Meal Pref | Arrival Time.
- Late-checkout hold: please provisionally reserve 5 west-wing suites as you suggested; we will populate names by Oct 12.

Thanks everyone — final confirmations below. I’ve inlined the key operational asks so nothing gets missed.

Final asks for hotel ops (please confirm receipt):
- Keycard cohorts: use floor-cluster grouping as recommended. Cohorts: Early (floors 2-3), Mid (floors 4-5), Late (floors 6-7). Please place colored tabbed envelopes at bell labeled EARLY / MID / LATE.
- Room tagging: provide both SILENT-HANGER (full door) and SILENT-CARD (bed/top-of-nightstand) for housekeeping. Tag design: white card with a small red dot (to stand out) and text: "Quiet Preference - Please Minimize Knock/Call".
- ADA/cribs: confirm roll-in showers for ADA rooms; if unavailable, swap to nearest accessible room (notify Marissa).
- Held rooms: west-wing suites x5 reserved until Oct 12 (we’ll populate names then).
- Dietary flags: Claire to upload vip_flags.csv by EOD Oct 6 — hotel to coordinate with culinary and confirm allergy-safe snack packs for meeting rooms.

Operational contacts: Mark Reynolds (hotel) is our on-site point. My mobile while onsite Oct 19: +1 (415) 555-0172. Marissa will be team lead for checkin ops.

Mark — please reply to confirm you have the SILENT tag specs and will provide the two variants. If you have a sample mockup, drop it to the Drive link below and we’ll approve.

Link: https://drive.redwood.com/exec_workshop/2026/onboarding_manifest (manifest & tag mockups)

Thanks — excited to have this all staged.
